_comment: DESKTOP preset. Performance is a HARD failure here, same severity as the mobile config —
both are 'error', not 'warn'. Only the floor differs: 0.95 here because both locales measure
1.00, vs. mobile's 0.85, which is the number mobile's throttled numbers actually clear.
Keeping the two presets at different floors (not different severities) is deliberate: mobile
is inherently harder (throttled CPU/network, two font subsets on the Mongolian page), so
holding it to the same 0.95 floor as desktop would either fail the build on a known, understood
gap or force lowering desktop's own floor to match — this keeps each preset's floor honest to
what it actually measures, without softening either one to a 'warn'.
